name: gText_Channel3
evidence: Record 3 of the four-channel pool: NA/EU base 0x800EB0F8 plus 3*0x64. DuelScene_Update reads its flags_34 0x2000 bit and destroys it to close the duel quit dialog; the main-menu trade screen destroys the same record. Japanese already addresses channel 3 as gJapanese_DuelQuitChannel at its own base+3*0x60.
notes: Former D_800EB224. Structural index name only: it does not assert that channel 3 is reserved for quit prompts. Preserve the unsized u8 declaration, the DuelEffectChannel casts, all native providers and the frozen main-menu overlay identifier.
